# Yi-Cheng Lin (林羿成)

> PhD student in the Graduate Institute of Communication Engineering, National Taiwan
> University, advised by Hung-yi Lee in the Speech Processing and Machine Learning Lab,
> and a Student Researcher at Google Cloud AI. Research on large audio-language models
> and fairness in speech processing: social bias in speech models, speech emotion
> recognition, and speech quality assessment.

Identifiers: ORCID 0009-0007-3994-6433 · Google Scholar N1UuQSUAAAAJ · Semantic Scholar 2284761645 · GitHub dlion168

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text map of the site for
retrieval systems. Every paper below has its own page carrying the abstract,
Google Scholar citation_* metadata, and a schema.org ScholarlyArticle block.

## Main pages

- [About](https://dlion168.github.io/): biography, current position, news
- [Publications](https://dlion168.github.io/publications/): all papers, grouped by year
- [CV](https://dlion168.github.io/cv/): education, experience, awards, service
- [News archive](https://dlion168.github.io/news/): full timeline
- [Repositories](https://dlion168.github.io/repositories/): code
